Winston carried twice for one yard in Thursday's 24-21 loss to the Commanders.

Johnson caught his only target for 15 yards during Sunday's 23-18 win versus the Jaguars.

Zvada made three of four field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
